Another option is to gather together a couple people to buy missing promos together (you're missing x,y, z; I'm missing x,y,z, and a,b,c kind of thing).  Since artscow prints 52 and you need four cards, you could put out a call to see who needs what and build a full deck then split it up among people. You just need to handle the shipping once you've received the artscow deck.

Ben

posts.name: seesome
posts.cooked:
I'm not too concerned with the print quality, so I printed out a set of promo cards for home use.  You can find PDF versions of the promo cards on Spiff's site.  The hero promos fit easily onto Avery 8164 labels and I just stuck them onto some old Magic: the Gathering land cards.  The prmo villains are oversized though, so I printed on regular paper, then cut and glued them onto comic book backing boards.

Works fine for me until GtG published their promised deck of promos & alts, then I'll pick up the official ones.
